interpretations: Count of joined advancedbehavior–transactionrecord rows per `ordertypedist` value, with patsim > 0.439 (strictly greater), inner join on transreg = translink, and NULL `ordertypedist` shown as its own group.
Count of distinct transactionrecord records (distinct transreg) per `ordertypedist` value, with patsim > 0.439, inner join, and NULL as its own group.
Count of distinct advancedbehavior records (distinct abhvreg) per `ordertypedist` value, with patsim > 0.439, inner join, and NULL as its own group.
Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value where the NULL group is labeled explicitly (e.g., "Unknown" or "Missing") instead of showing NULL.
Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value, with groups listed in descending order of count.
Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value, with groups listed alphabetically by order type mix.
Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value, with no specified ordering of the groups.
Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value where "missing mix" means only a NULL `ordertypedist`.
Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value where "missing mix" means NULL or an empty-string `ordertypedist`, grouped together as one group.

Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value where "matched records" means the advancedbehavior records that have at least one matching transaction record, counted once each even if they match several transaction records.
Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value where records with patsim NULL are excluded because they fail the > 0.439 comparison.
Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value where patsim > 0.439 is treated as inclusive (>= 0.439).
Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value where "missing mix" also covers any placeholder text value (e.g., 'Unknown', 'N/A') grouped together with NULL.
Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value where the matched records are counted at the trader level (distinct `trdref`).
Count of matched records per `ordertypedist` value using a left join, with unmatched advancedbehavior records counted in the NULL group.
queries:
SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM advancedbehavior a
INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink
WHERE a.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY t.ordertypedist;

SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS record_count
FROM transactionrecord t
INNER JOIN advancedbehavior a ON a.translink = t.transreg
WHERE a.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY t.ordertypedist;

SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT a.abhvreg) AS cnt
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg
WHERE a.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY t.ordertypedist

SELECT COALESCE(ordertypedist, 'Unknown') AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM transactionrecord
GROUP BY COALESCE(ordertypedist, 'Unknown')
SELECT ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS count FROM transactionrecord GROUP BY ordertypedist ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM transactionrecord
GROUP BY ordertypedist
ORDER BY ordertypedist ASC;
